name: ai-scientist
description: Codex-native AI Scientist workflows with auditable artifacts and validation gates.

interface.shortDescription: Run ideation, research loops, reviews, and writeups with strict scientific gates.
interface.longDescription: A Codex-native plugin that coordinates research workflows through skills, subagents, repository edits, and auditable .ai-scientist/ artifacts. It includes schema references, phase-gate validation, dependency/API controls, and leakage/split integrity requirements.
defaultPrompt: /ideate Generate experiment ideas for this repo.
Run research-loop on the selected idea with strict scientist mode.
Review this run and produce a writeup only if the verifier gate passes.
